results.description: I was asked by a colleague if it was possible to measure a curve, specifically, for the visor/shield for the Daft_Punk_Helmet, so that the visor could be laser cut from acrylic sheet and heated on a form to shape. When I imported the STL file into Solidworks, the translated the dimensions directly to inches which i wasn't able to work around. So, I remodeled the visor, scaled it down, and generated a flat surface that I could measure. I hope others find this useful as well.

results.description: Overview This project aims to archive all currently known bootlegs from Daft Punk's Alive 2006/2007 Tour Why? In a world where YouTube uploads and SoundCloud downloaders reign supreme, it is important to ensure that the original variants and versions of each of these bootlegs are archived in an easy-to-access location to avoid inferior versions being passed around, such as the case with the news outlet ElectroBlog who had notoriously distributed low-quality YouTube rips of a handful of Daft Punk bootlegs Note This archive has NOT been put together with the intent for these files to be re-uploaded to streaming platforms, as most (If not all) of these bootlegs are already up on platforms like YouTube, SoundCloud and Mixcloud, and uploading more copies to streaming sites is only harming the archival of these original  files, and making it easier for inferior / transcoded rips to be passed around. We have already started seeing 4th generation re-uploads appearing on YouTube  and being spread on places like SoulSeek , making for a file that has been re-encoded 5 times!!! How? Each bootleg has been meticulously verified and compared against reputable sources to ensure each is the original and / or highest quality file / rip of each set.   - For older bootlegs that originated from Scene releases and/or P2P sites (I.E. Napster, AudioGalaxy, Limewire etc.) the original (Or closest to original) version has been sourced from Blogs, Torrent Trackers and other distribution sites that hold copies of the recordings from around the time that these were initially distributed online.  - For those that only originated via streaming sites (I.E. SoundCloud, Mixcloud, YouTube etc.) these have been ripped from their respective original uploads (Not re-uploads) using the adequate tools / methods to extract the highest quality audio stream from each respective site.  - For those that originally originate from a video recording , the audio of these has been extracted from their respective original videos using tools that avoid the re-encoding of the audio.  - For those that have known physical releases (Tape, CD etc.) these have been ripped in FLAC and as close to 100% accuracy as possible (Where applicable) Additional Notes A handful of these recordings have been cropped so as to only include the sections that feature Daft Punk's set. This has been done with the aid of FFMPEG, which has allowed these to be cropped in a way that there would be no re-encoding or quality loss. Thanks Thanks to all of those who have assisted in the ripping and hunting process for this archive, your efforts have been extremely appreciated by myself as well as the wider community!
results.title: Daft Punk - Definitve Alive 2006 & Alive 2007 Bootleg Archive
